Subject: Q3 close: last-mile soft-commit sweep for EMEA / APAC

Hi Ali / HorizonTech team —

Quick heads-up as we head into the Q3 close window: finance is running a soft-commit sweep for all EMEA / APAC opportunities that are in late-stage (Proposal / Contract / Legal). We need a short confirmation of stage + expected close date so we can finalize the regional forecast.

Requests (one ask per account):
- Confirm current stage (Proposal / Contract / PO / Closed)
- If PO/Commit, indicate expected PO date and attach PO stub if available
- Tell us if the deal is at risk to slip this quarter (yes/no + short reason)

Deadline: EOD Friday, 22 May (EMEA close of business).

I've attached the Q3_forecast_template.xlsx and a short guideline (redwood_forecast_guidelines.pdf) — please use the template so finance can ingest cleanly. Also linking the HubSpot deal for reference: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/DEAL-HT-2027-045

If you'd prefer a 20–30m sync, we can hop on a quick call tomorrow — otherwise a one-line reply confirming the fields above works fine.

Thanks — appreciate the help to keep the commit clean for finance.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Exec, EMEA Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Q3_forecast_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- redwood_forecast_guidelines.pdf (pdf)
From: Ali Khan <ali.khan@horizontech.com>

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the heads-up. Quick answers for the HorizonTech opportunity:

- Stage: Contract (final redlines in legal)
- Expected PO date: targeted 26 May, but legal has one outstanding IP clause that may push to the 2nd week of June.
- Risk to slip: Potential (minor) — legal concern on IP indemnity; our procurement wants clearer language.

I'll upload the current contract redline and a one-line PO stub to the template by EOD Friday. If it helps, we can do a 20m call tomorrow at 10:00 CEST to walk through the redline items — I can bring our procurement lead.

—Ali
Ali Khan
Head of Strategic Accounts
HorizonTech

Ali — thanks for the quick reply and for offering the call. 10:00 CEST tomorrow works. I've scheduled a 20m slot and invited your procurement lead. Meeting invite: 2027-05-21T09:00:00+00:00 (calendar invite sent).

A couple of asks for the call and for the EOD Monday deliverable:
- If legal redlines are the blocker, please paste the specific clause line(s) that procurement wants changed into the template comment column so finance can triage impact.
- If you expect PO to land after the 22nd, mark the row as "soft-commit" with the expected PO date so finance can run a pessimistic scenario.

Finance will treat entries as follows unless otherwise noted: PO attached = 100% commit; Contract/Legal = 50% soft-commit; Verbal = 25% planning.

Thanks again — our goal is to minimize rework for your team. If you upload the PO stub to the template by Friday EOD we'll pull it into the close.

Best,
Vanessa
